basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and casual streamer from Seattle, WA. I love exploring open-world games like Sea of Thieves and sharing adventures with my friends on Discord. When I'm not gaming, I'm usually working as a software developer, with a focus on creating user-friendly applications. I enjoy tinkering with car mods and occasionally indulge in anime marathons. My typical online hours are late evenings, especially on weekends. Currently single and relishing the freedom to dive into my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Primarily self-taught in programming and game development, with a degree in Computer Science. I've spent countless hours learning through online courses and community forums, which has helped me stay up-to-date with the latest in tech and gaming.
